infra_error_definition: A provider or host outage before the agent produces any answer: a non-zero host exit, a provider 4xx/5xx or network error, or a recording-proxy failure. Retried at most 2 times, reported separately, and excluded from the denominator. A timeout, a budget breach, a judge_error, or any host exit after the agent has started answering counts as a run and stays in the denominator.

metadata.notes: Pilot prereg for tether (docs/plans/2026-10-24-001-feat-tether-method-plan.md). It is read by `eval pilot` only; `report` refuses pilot campaigns, and evals/tether/prereg.json (the RED/GREEN contract) does not exist yet. Two dev fixtures, no negatives, no held-out; five runs per arm per fixture. The rubric, fixtures and expectation sidecars are hashed here, and the pilot reads nothing else as evidence. Bars are placeholders: red_bar, green_bar, false_fire_max and accepted_error_rates are copied from the counterfactual epoch-5 shape only so the file parses. The pilot uses none of them. Baseline gate: other arms are built only if the baseline fails TE2 on ≥4 of 5 runs on both fixtures; otherwise not-reproduced. Decision rule: count runs passing both TE1 and TE2 over the pooled 10 runs per arm; go iff skill ≥ instruction + 2; instruction_present and skill_loaded recorded for every run, none excluded; tie or less → closed-instruction. maxWords is provisional at 250 (each ask states "under 250 words"); epoch 1 of evals/tether/prereg.json may revise it from pilot answer lengths. The pilot judge is unvalidated: no reviewer-judge agreement has been measured for TE1 or TE2, so pilot counts are an experiment outcome, not evidence for a matrix cell. Models: agent openai/gpt-6-luna and judge anthropic/claude-haiku-5-5 through the owner's CLIProxyAPI (key name fro-bot-marcusrbrown-metacogs), as in counterfactual epoch 5. Per-run timeout 180000 ms and the 20-call / 300000-token budget are the counterfactual values.
